Name: Zabdi, Father of Carmi
Summary: Zabdi, son of Zerah son of Judah, was the father of Carmi and the grandfather of Achan, whose sin troubled Israel.
KeyStory: Zabdi's household was taken by tribe, family, and man until Achan was found and his hidden plunder exposed.
RelatedPeople: Carmi, Son of Zabdi; Achan; Zerah, Son of Judah; Joshua
LifeLesson: What is buried in a tent cannot stay buried from God.
